list: The official PlayStation 5 list: 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze)

stages.title: Chapter 1 — Gone Fishing
stages.goal: Finish Gone Fishing for the first trophy, take the balcony meditation while Lucia offers it, and start the three slow counters early: the arcade console, Cal's fishing line and the WAiNK vehicle scan.
stages.note: The only real missable trophy in the game lives in this chapter.

stages.title: Chapter 2 — a partner in crime
stages.when: 11 missions · Jason and Lucia together in free roam
stages.goal: Take Breakfast Run, then use the partner: the wanted-level trophy, the gym, the bowling alley, the garage app and the Scooter Bros registrations all open here.
stages.note: Once the partner roams with you, Hot Together and Personal Best stop being chores and become a five-minute detour.

stages.title: Chapter 3 — the robberies open
stages.goal: Credit Check hands you the Dye Pack Jammer, which turns marked bills into money; the jewelry jobs hand you the Snap Gun and the three shops Retail Therapy wants.
stages.note: Bank and payday jobs unlock with Credit Check, jewelry stores with Yasmani's jobs. This is where the money trophies start paying.

stages.title: Chapter 4 — vaults and the airport
stages.when: 25 missions · after the optional job That's Where The Money Is…
stages.goal: Finish the chapter's four mission trophies, then use the vault unlock for Maximum Withdrawal and the 4-star chase for Hot Together.
stages.note: Vault robberies are the cleanest way to a guaranteed four-star wanted level.

stages.title: Chapter 5 — the last seven missions
stages.when: 7 missions · the end of the story
stages.goal: Operation Savage Glory and the final mission close the story and hand over the second gold. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing is lost by finishing.
stages.note: Story missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save before the final mission if you want to see the other ending choice.

stages.title: The 100% checklist
stages.goal: Work the checklist down: 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race locations, 30 race wins, 250 stunts, 50 challenges, 100 WAiNK scans, 3 card sets and 18 meditation spots.
stages.note: The checklist wants more than the trophies do — 70 challenges against 50, 300 stunts against 250, 200 vehicle scans against 100 — so the trophy targets come first and the checklist finishes the rest.

stages.title: Clean up: strangers, secrets and the platinum
stages.when: After the credits · free roam never ends
stages.goal: Close the stranger strands, chase the hidden one-offs and take the platinum once the other 54 are in.
stages.note: Every strand and every one-off stays available after the story; the hidden riddles are the only ones that need experimentation, so save first.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableReason: A platinum cannot be missed: it is the sum of the other 54, and every one of them stays reachable after the credits.
trophies.window: Any time — it lands the moment the 54th other trophy does.
trophies.guide: The platinum is not its own task: it fires when the other 54 are on the list, so treat it as a receipt rather than a goal. Everything it needs is single-player, so no subscription and no online mode is involved. Budget around 200 hours and a 4-out-of-10 difficulty, most of it the 100% checklist rather than anything hard. The one thing that can spoil the run is a cheat code: cheats switch trophies and saving off, so keep a clean save for them.
steps: Track the 54 others in this app; the platinum needs no separate step.
Keep one manual save that has never seen a cheat code.
Finish the 100% checklist last — it carries the two golds and most of the grind.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableReason: It unlocks with the first main mission of the game; you cannot reach free roam without finishing it.
trophies.window: Chapter 1, mission one — automatic.
trophies.guide: The opening mission of the story, and the only trophy in the game that asks nothing of you: finish Gone Fishing and it pops on the closing cutscene. Use the mission as a lesson instead of a race. The shooting section is where Combat Focus is introduced, and the same mechanic carries Gunslinger later, so learn the timing now rather than at a gang hideout with five targets on you. When the cutscene ends and free roam opens, make a manual save — that save is the clean checkpoint the rest of the roadmap assumes.
steps: Play the mission without skipping the tutorial prompts; they are the tutorial for Combat Focus and cover.
Let the end cutscene run — the trophy fires on it, not on the last kill.
Save manually the moment control returns.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableReason: No checklist requirement is missable: the checklist opens after the story and everything on it can still be done in free roam.
trophies.window: After the story · Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
trophies.guide: The second gold and the real length of the platinum: roughly a hundred hours on top of the story. The checklist only appears under Progress, Stats once the story is done, but progress you made earlier already counts, so nothing before the credits is wasted. It is not a true 100% of the game: it wants about 60% of what exists — 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional tasks, 300 of 397 stunts — while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting requests want every item. Leave the slack categories for last and skip the hardest entries in each.
steps: Finish the story first; the checklist only shows itself afterwards.
Clear the all-or-nothing lines (42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone races, 39 gang operations, 22 banks, 33 underwater discoveries, 15 target decks).
Fill the slack lines to their required count and leave the hardest 25–30% of each alone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableReason: Every stunt stays on the map after the story; the trophy asks for 250 of 397, so there is slack as well.
trophies.window: Any time — easier with an aircraft, which arrives with the story.
trophies.guide: Stunts are four activities counted as one: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. You need any 250, and doing a stunt once is enough — the extra challenges attached to its map icon are not required. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest of the four because the aircraft does the work and the gaps are everywhere along the coast; knife flights are the fiddly ones and worth skipping. Track it under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and see discovered spots under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
steps: Get a fast plane or helicopter and work the bridges first — 202 of them exist.
Take stunt jumps on the way between missions; 130 exist and they are short.
Stop at 250; the checklist wants 300 but the trophy does not.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

trophies.window: Any time — some challenges unlock as the story gives you the weapons.
trophies.guide: Forty-two gold medals across the shooting ranges, and every one of them is repeatable, so nothing here can be lost — it is purely a matter of patience. Push Square names the two flagship ranges as Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, while PowerPyx counts twelve ranges holding the 42 medals between them; either way, use the map filter under Activities, Shooting Ranges to find them all. Most challenges carry three difficulty tiers and each tier has its own gold, so work a range top to bottom rather than hopping. Weapons unlock through the story, which is why this is a post-credits job.
steps: Open the map, filter Activities, Shooting Ranges, and work one range at a time.
Take each challenge through all three tiers — each tier holds its own gold.
Return after the story if a challenge is locked for want of a weapon.

steps: Open Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn in Chapter 2.
Take the watch, the unique shotgun and the safe — bring sticky bombs for the safe.
Escape the police; the robbery comes back if you missed an item.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableReason: Gyms stay open after the story and strength can be trained at any time.
trophies.window: After a Chapter 2 mission, with your partner
trophies.guide: The riddle resolves to strength: raise it to the maximum on both Jason and Lucia. The trick is to train with your partner along, because while you work one character the other trains too — so one session covers both. Gyms open up properly after a Chapter 2 mission, and the training is a slow grind of minigames rather than a single feat, so start it early and let it run in the background of other errands.
steps: Wait for a Chapter 2 mission so the gyms and the partner are both available.
Train with your partner present; both characters gain strength at once.
Keep going until both bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableReason: Choices can be made in free roam indefinitely, so the counter can always be finished.
trophies.window: Any time · 500 choices that move your Criminal Profile
trophies.guide: Five hundred choices that shift your Criminal Profile, and the trophy list carries the counter. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications so you can see each choice register; without them the counter feels random. Most players reach 500 just by playing, which is why this is a cleanup trophy rather than a grind — if you are short at the end, ordinary free-roam decisions (how you handle a pedestrian, a shop, a traffic stop) keep adding to it.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings.
Play normally and watch the trophy counter under the list.
Top up in free roam with ordinary decisions if you finish the story short.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableReason: The event is a night encounter in the open world, repeatable across sessions rather than tied to a chapter's end.
trophies.window: From Chapter 2 · at night, east of Port Gellhorn
trophies.guide: The UFO encounter, and the one hidden trophy with a published walkthrough: GamesHorizon described it on 19 November 2026. From Chapter 2, go at night to the rural roads east of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, a few hundred metres from the Starlet Motel safehouse; the author saw it most reliably after 2 AM in game time. Look for a parked car facing a woodland trail, boot open, lights flickering, clothes on the ground. Take the trail with your flashlight to the misty clearing, talk to the figure twice, then fetch the car from the trailhead — the UFO appears overhead and the trophy lands.
steps: After Chapter 2, drive the rural roads east of Port Gellhorn at night, ideally after 2 AM in game time.
Find the car with its boot open by a woodland trail, and follow the trail with your flashlight.
Talk to the figure twice in the clearing, then bring the car back from the trailhead.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableReason: Marked bills keep coming from robberies that respawn, so the total can always be reached.
trophies.window: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check
trophies.guide: Marked bills are the cash from banks and payday loan offices, and they are worthless until a fence takes them. The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check gives you the Dye Pack Jammer, which is the unlock that lets a fence accept them at all — so this trophy cannot start before that mission. The $250,000 adds up across deliveries rather than needing one big sale, and Yasmani in Little Cuba pays the best rate. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so the trophy and the checklist are the same job.
steps: Play to Credit Check in Chapter 3 for the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loan offices for marked bills.
Sell them to a fence — Yasmani in Little Cuba pays best — until $250,000 has gone through.

Clothes and haircuts count too, so if you would rather not buy weapons you can dress your way there, but it will take longer. The shops are on the map under Style. This pairs naturally with Little Boxes and On the Spot, which both want you to spend on property and vehicles anyway.
steps: Spend on the big-ticket shelves: weapons, car mods, tattoos.
Use the map's Style filter to find shops you have not visited.
Combine with garage and vehicle purchases so the money does double duty.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableReason: The properties stay for sale for the whole game.
trophies.window: After a Chapter 2 mission · Vice City Real Estate app
trophies.guide: Eight garages, sold through the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone, which appears after a Chapter 2 mission. Push Square lists them with prices: Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000, Persistence Road at $7,600, 7th Avenue at $12,000, Store n' Bolt at $16,800, Wyatt Motors at $21,600, Vela Rota Drive at $24,000, Bonita Court at $34,000 and Atlantic Court at $40,000 — $160,000 in all. Each holds one car, and story garages do not count, so buy the cheap ones early: they are also the parking spots On the Spot needs.
steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app after a Chapter 2 mission.
Buy the cheap garages first: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, Persistence Road $7,600, 7th Avenue $12,000.
Finish the set — all eight, $160,000, one parking spot each.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableReason: Vehicles can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray for the whole game.
trophies.window: After a Chapter 2 mission · needs ten free parking spots
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros delivers a registered car to you for a fee, and you need ten different vehicles on the list. Registering happens at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop and each registration needs an empty parking spot, so this is gated behind garages: buy the eight from Little Boxes first and you have eight slots, then add the story garages. Moses in Port Gellhorn can register the first ones for you. Register cheap, common cars — the fee scales with the vehicle's value, so a fleet of beaters costs less than a fleet of supercars.
steps: Buy garages first — eight from Little Boxes, plus any story garages — so there are spots free.
Drive a car to a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop and register it.
Repeat with ten different cheap vehicles; the fee rises with the car's value.
